222-527-4359-8249.easyPrerequisites:
You control a Saproling.
You control a creature with power 5 or greater.
222-527-4359-8249.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {1}{B}{R}{G}{G}.
Activate Defiant Salvager twice by sacrificing Selvala and Slimefoot and Squee.
Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {1}{B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling, returning it and Selvala from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Slimefoot and Squee enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Repeat.

1479-2638-2841-8103.easyPrerequisites:
It is not your turn.
There is a land card in your library that can be fetched using Verdant Catacombs.
Your life total is 2 or higher.
1479-2638-2841-8103.description:
Fetch a land using Verdant Catacombs.
When the fetched land enters, Tireless Tracker and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Kodama and Tireless Tracker trigger.
Holding priority, activate Ghost Town's first abiltiy by tapping it, adding {C}.
Activate Ghost Town's second ability by paying {0}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Tireless Tracker from step 4, creating a token.
When the token enters, Kodama triggers, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Tireless Tracker triggers.
Repeat from step 5.

240-728-5470-6633.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one creature token that entered the battlefield this turn.
Grimgrin is untapped and does not have summoning sickness.
240-728-5470-6633.description:
Activate Atla by paying {2} and tapping it, creating an 0/1 Egg creature token with defender.
Activate a nontoken creature you control using the ability granted to it by Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Egg token.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing an Egg token.
When the Egg dies, Atla triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Grimgrin ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Grimgrin and untapping it
Repeat from step 2.
Activate Grimgrin by tapping it, creating a token copy of any creature token you control that entered the battlefield this turn.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the creature token created in step 1, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

3129-4772-4826-6441-7942.description:
Activate Saurian Explorer by paying {6}, creating eight untapped New Planet tokens due to the three token doublers and Archelos.
Activate six of the tokens by tapping them, adding {6}.
Repeat

359-372-1621.manaNeeded: {6}{W}{W} plus enough mana to pay commander tax, if applicable
359-372-1621.description:
Cast Abdel Adrian either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {4}{W} and commander tax, if applicable.
When Abdel Adrian enters the battlefield, it triggers, exiling Wispweaver Angel until Abedl Adrian leaves the battlefield and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Cast Acrobatic Maneuver by paying its mana cost, blinking Abdel Adrian.
Abdel Adrian leaves and enters the battlefield, causing Wispweaver Angel to return to the battlefield from exile, and triggering Abdel Adrian and Wispweaver Angel's enter abilities.
Resolve the Abdel Adrian trigger, exiling Wispweaver Angel until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Resolve the Wispweaver Angel trigger, blinking Abdel Adrian.
Repeat from step 4.

338-3641-7690--165.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
338-3641-7690--165.description:
Gain life.
The other Hero triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it
Invisible Woman triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Distinguished Conjurer triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat from step 2.

1368-4460-6006-6321.notablePrerequisites: You have at least three other cards in your graveyard.
1368-4460-6006-6321.description:
Cast Malevolent Rumble for its escape cost by paying {1}{G} and exiling three other cards from your graveyard, causing you to mill at least three cards and create a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
Repeat.

2440-3581-7109-7175.description:
Cast Trusty Boomerang by paying {1}.
Kykar triggers, creating a 1/1 Spirit creature token.
When the Spirit enters, Mana Echoes triggers, adding {C} for each Spirit you control.
Activate Trusty Boomerang's equip ability by paying {1}, attaching it to the Spirit token.
Activate the Spirit token by paying {1} and tapping it, tapping a creature a returning Trusty Boomerang from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.
2440-3581-7109-7175.notes: The cost can be reduced to as little as {1} if you control other Spirits. You can also sacrifice the Spirits once you have enough to get infinite {R}.

4613-4968-6843-7186.description:
Activate Anti-Venom using Deathbringer Thoctar's ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, targeting itself and putting two +1/+1 counters on it due to its replacement effect and Collective Inferno.
Activate Anti-Venom using Deathbringer Thoctar's ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

requires.n: Effects that Alter a Creature's Power/Toughness (Anthem Effects)

4352-5256-6972--112.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Maulfist Squad.
When Maulfist Squad dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Maulfist Squad enters, its fabricate ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Repeat.
4352-5256-6972--112.notes: The chosen anthem effect must boost Maulfist Squad's toughness by at least 1 so it doesn't die from the -1/-1 counter.

413-1286-5972.notablePrerequisites:
You control an Aura that is attached to another creature you control.
You control at least one additional creature beyond the creature that has the Aura attached.
413-1286-5972.description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing another creature that has an Aura attached to it.
When the creature dies, Cass triggers, returning an Aura that was attached to the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to another creature you control.
When the Aura enters the battlefield, Ajani's Chosen triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 1.
Repeat.

24-593-1640.description:
Cast Wheel of Misfortune by paying {2}{R}, choosing an arbitrarily large number and having Wheel of Misfortune deal that much damage to Mogg Maniac instead of you due to Pariah's Shield if you chose the largest number.
Mogg Maniac triggers, dealing that much damage to an applicable target.
24-593-1640.notes: If you didn't choose the highest number, Wheel of Misfortune will deal damage to the opponent(s) who did equal to that number.

104-4929-6805.description:
Activate Royal Herbalist by paying {2} and exiling the top card of your library, causing you to gain 2 life.
Cleric Class triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Cryptic Trilobite.
Activate Cryptic Trilobite by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {C}{C} that can only be spent to activate abilities.
Repeat.

883-5670-6792--5.easyPrerequisites: Your life total is 2 or higher.
883-5670-6792--5.description:
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing the persist creature.
When the persist creature dies, its persist ability and Ashes of the Abhorrent trigger.
Resolve the persist trigger, returning the persist creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
Resolve the Ashes of the Abhorrent trigger, causing you to gain 1 life
Resolve the Warren Soultrader ability, creating a Treasure token.
When the Treasure enters, Mm'menon triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the persist creature.
Repeat.

2732-5686-6132.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Metamorphosis Fanatic.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic dies, Prowling Geistcatcher's first ability triggers, exiling Metamorphosis Fanatic from your graveyard.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Prowling Geistcatcher.
When Prowling Geistcatcher dies, its second ability triggers, returning Metamorphosis Fanatic from exile to the battlefield.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Prowling Geistcatcher from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Repeat.

3152-4415-6623.description:
Activate Somberwald Sage by tapping it, adding {W}{W}{W}.
Cast Stonecloaker by paying its mana cost.
Chakram Retriever triggers, untapping Somberwald Sage.
When Stonecloaker enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

1491-2757-4565-6218.easyPrerequisites: Sinking Feeling attached to Pheres-Band Tromper.
1491-2757-4565-6218.description:
Activate a basic land by tapping it, adding {1}.
Activate Earthcraft by tapping Pheres-Band Tromper, untapping a basic land you control.
Activate Pheres-Band Tromper by paying {1} and putting a -1/-1 counter on it, untapping it.
Pheres-Band Tromper triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Repeat.

1432-5963.notablePrerequisites:
There is at least one other legendary creature on the battlefield.
Marvin and Ioreth do not have summoning sickness.
1432-5963.description:
Activate Marvin using Ioreth's second ability by tapping it, untapping Ioreth and another legendary creature.
Activate Ioreth's second ability by tapping it, untapping Marvin and another legendary creature.
Repeat.

3284-4050-4550-4871.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
3284-4050-4550-4871.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing another creature, adding one mana of any color.
Korvold's second ability and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Korvold trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on it and causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding one mana of any color.
Korvold's second ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it and causing you to draw a card.
Activate Zombie Infestation by discarding two cards, creating a 2/2 Zombie creature token.
Repeat.

3581-4867-5487.description:
Activate Cormela by paying {1} and tapping it, adding {U}{B}{R} that can only be spent to cast instant and/or sorcery spells.
Cast Molten Duplication by paying {1}{R}.
Kykar triggers, creating a 1/1 Spirit creature token.
Resolve Molten Duplication, creating a token copy of Cormela.
Put the tapped Cormela into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When Cormela dies, it triggers, returning Molten Duplication from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate Kykar by sacrificing the Spirit, adding {R}.
Repeat.

140-2871-5195.notablePrerequisites:
You have lost at least 3 life this turn.
Rowan does not have summoning sickness.
140-2871-5195.description:
Activate Rowan by tapping it, reducing the cost of all black and/or red spells you cast this turn by at least {3}.
Cast Seething Anger with buyback by paying {R} due to Rowan's ability, targeting any creature.
Storm-Kiln Artist triggers, creating a Treasure artifact token.
Resolve Seething Anger, giving target creature +3/+0 until end of turn and returning Seething Anger to your hand.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {R}.
Repeat from step 2.

1751-2743-3280.description:
Cast Storm King's Thunder by paying {2}{R}{R}{R}, copying the next instant or sorcery spell you cast twice.
Cast Croaking Counterpart by paying {1}{G}{U}, targeting Biovisionary.
Storm King's Thunder triggers, copying Croaking Counterpart twice, with both copies targeting Biovisionary.
Resolve all Croaking Counterparts, creating three token copies of Biovisionary that are 1/1 Frogs.
At the beginning of your end step, each Biovisionary triggers.
Resolve the first trigger, causing you to win the game.

79-1912-4013.description:
Activate Eldrazi Displacer by paying {C}, blinking Birthing Hulk.
Birthing Hulk enters the battlefield, creating two 1/1 colorless Eldrazi Scion tokens.
Activate Eldrazi Scion by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
Repeat.
